name: patchboard
description: PatchBoard is a basic applicaiton to keep track of software projects and their known bugs and problems waiting to be patched. Each issue has a status indicator indicating whether it is waiting for a patch, in progress, or patched.

scripts.build: tsc && tsc -p tsconfig.shared.json && cp dist-cjs/shared/bugStatuses.js dist/shared/bugStatuses.js && cp dist-cjs/shared/bugPriorities.js dist/shared/bugPriorities.js && rm -rf dist-cjs
